final: WITH g AS (SELECT a.player_id AS pid, p.death_country AS dc, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS s FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), o AS (SELECT AVG(s) AS av FROM g WHERE s IS NOT NULL) SELECT SUM(g.s) AS total_sum, AVG(g.s - o.av) AS avg_excess FROM g JOIN o ON o.av IS NOT NULL WHERE g.s > o.av
